Paris Baguette Serves Treats and Tickets for ‘Dancing with the Stars’ Season 35 Premiere

This collab deserves a 10.

September 10, 2026 by Cassandra Schilling
< 1
  • Share
  • Link to X
  • Link to Linkedin
  • Link to Instagram
  • Link to Facebook
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:15
Instaread

Get on your dancing shoes. Dancing with the Stars is about to enter its 35th season, and Paris Baguette is teaming up with the show to celebrate. 

As part of the collaboration, Paris Baguette is launching two limited-edition drinks Sept. 14. The Mirrorball Croissant Iced Latte blends a rich croissant flavor with Lavazza espresso and milk. The Mirrorball Croissant Iced Matcha has a savory croissant taste mixed with milk and ceremonial-grade matcha. Both drinks are finished with mirrorball accents.

Based on the memorable Len Goodman Mirrorball Trophy, the drinks are served with Paris Baguette’s mouthwatering croissants and exclusive Dancing with the Stars cup sleeves. As part of a BOGO free deal, rewards members can try one of the drinks for free Sept. 19, also known as National Dance Day. 

As if it couldn’t get better, fans can win the chance to see Dancing with the Stars live. Starting Oct. 1, Paris Baguette is launching an Instagram sweepstakes through its account, @parisbaguette_usa. The winner gets two free tickets to the finale, a $100 gift card, and their airfare, transportation, and two hotel nights covered. 

RELATED

Give Three Cheers to Gnarly Head’s Latest Grateful Dead Wine

Learn more about the exciting collab at parisbaguette.com. Don’t forget to tune in to the first episode of Dancing with the Stars Sept. 15!
